import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
base = Path('../checks/parametric')
root = Path.cwd()
rows = []
for folder in [base / 'all-settings', base / 'sampled-episode']:
    summary = json.loads((folder / 'private/summary.json').read_text())
    for path, expected in summary['source_sha256'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, path
    runtime = json.loads((folder / 'private/racket-runtime.json').read_text())
    assert runtime['protected'] is True
    parity = json.loads((folder / 'private/canonical-parity.json').read_text())
    assert parity['program_exact_match'] and parity['passed'] and len(parity['cases']) == 3
    contrast = json.loads((folder / 'private/contrast.json').read_text())
    assert len({json.dumps(grid) for grid in contrast['outputs'].values()}) == 4
    episode_files = list(folder.glob('episode-*/private/episode.json')) or [folder / 'private/episode.json']
    for path in sorted(episode_files):
        private = json.loads(path.read_text())
        public = json.loads((path.parent.parent / 'public/challenge.json').read_text())
        assert set(public) == {'train', 'test'}
        assert all(set(pair) == {'input', 'output'} for pair in public['train'])
        assert all(set(pair) == {'input'} for pair in public['test'])
        keys = [json.dumps(pair['input']) for split in ('train', 'test') for pair in public[split]]
        assert len(set(keys)) == len(keys) == private['unique_input_count']
        assert len(public['test']) == len(private['answers']) == 4
        assert hashlib.sha256(path.with_name('program.rkt').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == private['program_sha256']
        assert private['lesson_check']['identified']
        assert len(private['lesson_check']['surviving_settings']) == 1
        for check in private['lesson_check']['queries']:
            assert check['identifiable_from_demos'] and not check['remaining_differing_rivals']
            assert len(check['refuting_demo_indices']) == 3
            assert all(indices and max(indices) < len(public['train']) for indices in check['refuting_demo_indices'].values())
        rows.append({'episode': str(path.parent.parent), 'parameters': private['parameters'], 'train': len(public['train']), 'test': len(public['test']), 'unique_inputs': len(keys), 'program_sha256': private['program_sha256'], 'query_nonzero_cells': [sum(v != 0 for row in pair['input'] for v in row) for pair in public['test']]})
report = {'passed': True, 'episodes': rows, 'episode_count': len(rows), 'query_count': sum(row['test'] for row in rows), 'scope': 'retained artifact identities, public/private separation, uniqueness, protected runtime, demo-only finite-family checks'}
(base / 'artifact-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True))
